title: Protocol Response
description: Protocol-level response wrapper (MCP/A2A) - contains AdCP task data plus protocol fields

message.description: Human-readable summary. At most 2,000 characters, and untrusted input to the receiver: see core/task-message.json.

context_id.description: Transport-managed conversation identifier. Maps to native contextId on A2A; compatibility metadata only on MCP and not a continuation or authorization mechanism.

data.description: AdCP task-specific response data (see individual task response schemas)
